definition: to study something carefully in order to understand it
example: We need to analyze the logs before we decide what went wrong.
exampleEs: Tenemos que analizar los registros antes de decidir qué salió mal.
cloze: We need to ____ the logs before we decide what went wrong.
note: Spelled analyse in British English; the noun is analysis.

definition: to think that something is true without having proof
example: Don't assume that the client has read the report.
exampleEs: No des por hecho que el cliente ha leído el informe.
cloze: Don't ____ that the client has read the report.
note: Not the same as 'asumir' in the sense of accepting; it usually means 'suppose'.

definition: large or important enough to have a clear effect or to be noticed
example: There was a significant drop in server errors after the update.
exampleEs: Hubo una caída considerable de errores del servidor después de la actualización.
cloze: There was a ____ drop in server errors after the update.

definition: a way of dealing with a problem or a task
example: Our team took a different approach to the migration.
exampleEs: Nuestro equipo adoptó un enfoque distinto para la migración.
cloze: Our team took a different ____ to the migration.
note: Use the preposition 'to': an approach to the problem.

definition: facts or signs that show that something is true
example: There is strong evidence that sleep improves memory.
exampleEs: Hay pruebas sólidas de que dormir mejora la memoria.
cloze: There is strong ____ that sleep improves memory.
note: Uncountable: say 'some evidence', not 'an evidence' or 'evidences'.

definition: one of the things that influence a result or a decision
example: Price was the deciding factor for most of our customers.
exampleEs: El precio fue el factor decisivo para la mayoría de nuestros clientes.
cloze: Price was the deciding ____ for most of our customers.

definition: to need something, or to make something necessary
example: This role requires strong communication skills in English.
exampleEs: Este puesto requiere buenas habilidades de comunicación en inglés.
cloze: This role ____ strong communication skills in English.
note: Needs no preposition: require something, not require of something.

definition: always behaving or happening in the same way, or not contradicting something else
example: Her results have been consistent across all three experiments.
exampleEs: Sus resultados han sido consistentes en los tres experimentos.
cloze: Her results have been ____ across all three experiments.
note: 'Consistent' means steady or coherent, not 'consistente' as in thick or firm.

definition: to get something from a source, or to come from a source
example: Many English words derive from Latin.
exampleEs: Muchas palabras en inglés derivan del latín.
cloze: Many English words ____ from Latin.
note: Use 'from': derive from.

definition: to guess the amount or value of something using the information you have
example: We estimate that the project will take about six weeks.
exampleEs: Calculamos que el proyecto tomará unas seis semanas.
cloze: We ____ that the project will take about six weeks.
note: As a noun it is pronounced with a weaker ending: a rough estimate.

definition: to show that something exists or is true
example: The data indicate that most users abandon the app on the first day.
exampleEs: Los datos indican que la mayoría de los usuarios abandona la app el primer día.
cloze: The data ____ that most users abandon the app on the first day.

definition: to decide what something means
example: It is easy to interpret these numbers in the wrong way.
exampleEs: Es fácil interpretar estas cifras de manera equivocada.
cloze: It is easy to ____ these numbers in the wrong way.
note: Also used for spoken translation: an interpreter.

definition: to get something, usually through effort or a formal process
example: You must obtain permission before you share the dataset.
exampleEs: Debes obtener permiso antes de compartir el conjunto de datos.
cloze: You must ____ permission before you share the dataset.
note: More formal than 'get'.

definition: to happen, especially without being planned
example: The error only occurs when two users save at the same time.
exampleEs: El error solo ocurre cuando dos usuarios guardan al mismo tiempo.
cloze: The error only ____ when two users save at the same time.
note: Spelling: occur has double c, and occurred has double r.

definition: to start something that is meant to last, or to prove that something is true
example: The company established its first office in Mexico City in 2019.
exampleEs: La empresa estableció su primera oficina en la Ciudad de México en 2019.
cloze: The company ____ its first office in Mexico City in 2019.

definition: to succeed in getting a result by working hard
example: If you practice daily, you can achieve fluency within a year.
exampleEs: Si practicas a diario, puedes lograr fluidez en un año.
cloze: If you practice daily, you can ____ fluency within a year.
note: Pronounced /əˈtʃiːv/; the noun is achievement.

definition: to give something, such as money, time or ideas, to help achieve something
example: Everyone on the team contributed ideas to the new design.
exampleEs: Todos en el equipo aportaron ideas al nuevo diseño.
cloze: Everyone on the team ____ ideas to the new design.
note: Use 'to': contribute to a project.

definition: to recognize something and say what it is
example: The tool helps developers identify security problems early.
exampleEs: La herramienta ayuda a los desarrolladores a identificar problemas de seguridad desde temprano.
cloze: The tool helps developers ____ security problems early.

definition: to include something as a necessary part
example: The job involves attending meetings with teams in several countries.
exampleEs: El trabajo implica asistir a reuniones con equipos de varios países.
cloze: The job ____ attending meetings with teams in several countries.
note: After 'involve' use the -ing form: involves attending, not involves to attend.

definition: to keep something in good condition or at the same level
example: It is hard to maintain focus during a long online meeting.
exampleEs: Es difícil mantener la concentración durante una reunión virtual larga.
cloze: It is hard to ____ focus during a long online meeting.

definition: to move something or someone from one place or person to another
example: We plan to transfer all the files to the new server tonight.
exampleEs: Planeamos transferir todos los archivos al nuevo servidor esta noche.
cloze: We plan to ____ all the files to the new server tonight.
note: Stress changes: to transFER (verb), a TRANSfer (noun).

definition: a factor that can change, especially in an experiment or a calculation
example: In this test we change only one variable at a time.
exampleEs: En esta prueba cambiamos solo una variable a la vez.
cloze: In this test we change only one ____ at a time.

definition: as much as is needed
example: Three examples are sufficient to explain the idea.
exampleEs: Tres ejemplos son suficientes para explicar la idea.
cloze: Three examples are ____ to explain the idea.
note: More formal than 'enough'.

definition: a clear difference between two things that are compared
example: There is a sharp contrast between the two companies' cultures.
exampleEs: Hay un fuerte contraste entre las culturas de las dos empresas.
cloze: There is a sharp ____ between the two companies' cultures.
note: Pronounced CON-trast as a noun.

definition: to show that something is especially important
example: The manager emphasized that the deadline cannot move.
exampleEs: El gerente subrayó que la fecha límite no se puede mover.
cloze: The manager ____ that the deadline cannot move.
note: The noun is emphasis (not emphasize). Say 'emphasize that' without a preposition.

definition: to put a plan, system or decision into action
example: We will implement the new login flow next sprint.
exampleEs: Implementaremos el nuevo flujo de inicio de sesión en el próximo sprint.
cloze: We will ____ the new login flow next sprint.

definition: the final result of an action, process or meeting
example: The outcome of the meeting was a clear list of next steps.
exampleEs: El resultado de la reunión fue una lista clara de próximos pasos.
cloze: The ____ of the meeting was a clear list of next steps.

definition: possible in the future, but not yet real
example: We should discuss the potential risks before we sign the contract.
exampleEs: Deberíamos hablar de los posibles riesgos antes de firmar el contrato.
cloze: We should discuss the ____ risks before we sign the contract.
note: As a noun it means 'capacity to develop': she has great potential.

definition: a place, person or thing that provides information or something you need
example: Always check that your source is reliable.
exampleEs: Siempre verifica que tu fuente sea confiable.
cloze: Always check that your ____ is reliable.
note: Pronounced /sɔːrs/, like 'sauce' with an r.

definition: a general direction in which something is changing or developing
example: The report shows a growing trend toward remote work.
exampleEs: El informe muestra una tendencia creciente hacia el trabajo remoto.
cloze: The report shows a growing ____ toward remote work.

definition: something that limits what you can do
example: Our biggest constraint is the budget, not the technology.
exampleEs: Nuestra mayor restricción es el presupuesto, no la tecnología.
cloze: Our biggest ____ is the budget, not the technology.

definition: the standards used to judge or decide something (singular: criterion)
example: The criteria for choosing a vendor are cost, security and support.
exampleEs: Los criterios para elegir un proveedor son costo, seguridad y soporte.
cloze: The ____ for choosing a vendor are cost, security and support.
note: Plural form: criteria are, not criteria is. One item is a criterion.

definition: to make certain that something happens or is true
example: Please ensure that everyone has access to the document.
exampleEs: Por favor, asegúrate de que todos tengan acceso al documento.
cloze: Please ____ that everyone has access to the document.
note: Use 'ensure that', not 'ensure to'. Don't confuse with 'insure' (to buy insurance).

definition: to make something better or stronger
example: Good lighting can enhance the quality of your video calls.
exampleEs: Una buena iluminación puede mejorar la calidad de tus videollamadas.
cloze: Good lighting can ____ the quality of your video calls.

definition: to produce or create something
example: The model can generate a summary of each document in seconds.
exampleEs: El modelo puede generar un resumen de cada documento en segundos.
cloze: The model can ____ a summary of each document in seconds.

definition: a particular way of doing something
example: This method is faster, but it is also less accurate.
exampleEs: Este método es más rápido, pero también menos preciso.
cloze: This ____ is faster, but it is also less accurate.

definition: happening or existing before the present one
example: In my previous job, I worked mostly with Python.
exampleEs: En mi trabajo anterior, trabajaba sobre todo con Python.
cloze: In my ____ job, I worked mostly with Python.

definition: a set of different things of the same general type, or the limits between which something varies
example: The app offers a wide range of exercises for different levels.
exampleEs: La app ofrece una amplia gama de ejercicios para distintos niveles.
cloze: The app offers a wide ____ of exercises for different levels.
note: Say 'a wide range of', not 'a lot of ranges'.

definition: directly connected to the subject you are talking about
example: Only share information that is relevant to the project.
exampleEs: Comparte solo la información que sea pertinente para el proyecto.
cloze: Only share information that is ____ to the project.
note: Use 'relevant to', not 'relevant for' in most cases.

definition: to limit the size, amount or range of something
example: The company restricts access to customer data.
exampleEs: La empresa restringe el acceso a los datos de los clientes.
cloze: The company ____ access to customer data.

definition: a set of things that come one after another in a particular order
example: Follow this sequence of steps to reset your password.
exampleEs: Sigue esta secuencia de pasos para restablecer tu contraseña.
cloze: Follow this ____ of steps to reset your password.

definition: to give a document or request to someone so that they can consider it
example: You have to submit the form by Friday at noon.
exampleEs: Tienes que entregar el formulario el viernes al mediodía.
cloze: You have to ____ the form by Friday at noon.
note: Not 'someter' in the sense of controlling; it means to hand in.

definition: to start a task or a project and take responsibility for it
example: The team will undertake a full review of the system.
exampleEs: El equipo emprenderá una revisión completa del sistema.
cloze: The team will ____ a full review of the system.
note: Irregular: undertake, undertook, undertaken.

definition: based on good reasons, or legally and officially acceptable
example: That is a valid point, but we still need more data.
exampleEs: Ese es un punto válido, pero todavía necesitamos más datos.
cloze: That is a ____ point, but we still need more data.

definition: an unfair preference for or against something, based on personal opinion
example: The researchers tried to reduce bias in how they chose participants.
exampleEs: Los investigadores intentaron reducir el sesgo al elegir a los participantes.
cloze: The researchers tried to reduce ____ in how they chose participants.
note: Use 'bias against' or 'bias toward'. Common in AI and psychology.

definition: to happen at the same time, or to be the same
example: My exam dates coincide with a big release at work.
exampleEs: Las fechas de mis exámenes coinciden con un lanzamiento importante en el trabajo.
cloze: My exam dates ____ with a big release at work.
note: Always 'coincide with', never 'coincide in' for time.

definition: made of many parts and difficult to understand
example: The legal rules for clinical trials are very complex.
exampleEs: Las reglas legales de los ensayos clínicos son muy complejas.
cloze: The legal rules for clinical trials are very ____.
note: Not the same as 'complicado' in all uses, but close. Not 'complexed'.

definition: an idea about how something is or should be
example: The concept is simple, but building it takes months.
exampleEs: El concepto es simple, pero construirlo toma meses.
cloze: The ____ is simple, but building it takes months.

definition: to organize and do an activity, such as a survey or an experiment
example: We conducted a survey with two hundred users last month.
exampleEs: Realizamos una encuesta con doscientos usuarios el mes pasado.
cloze: We ____ a survey with two hundred users last month.
note: As a verb the stress is on the second syllable: conDUCT.

definition: the situation or background that helps you understand something
example: Without context, that sentence can be misunderstood.
exampleEs: Sin contexto, esa frase se puede malinterpretar.
cloze: Without ____, that sentence can be misunderstood.

definition: extremely important because everything else depends on it
example: It is crucial to confirm the requirements before we start coding.
exampleEs: Es crucial confirmar los requisitos antes de empezar a programar.
cloze: It is ____ to confirm the requirements before we start coding.
note: Stronger than 'important'; it replaces 'very, very important'.

definition: to show clearly that something is true, or to show how something works
example: The experiment demonstrates that small changes can have large effects.
exampleEs: El experimento demuestra que los cambios pequeños pueden tener grandes efectos.
cloze: The experiment ____ that small changes can have large effects.

definition: clearly different from something else, or easy to notice
example: The two teams have distinct roles, so they rarely overlap.
exampleEs: Los dos equipos tienen funciones distintas, así que rara vez se traslapan.
cloze: The two teams have ____ roles, so they rarely overlap.
note: Not the same as 'different' in tone: it stresses a clear separation.

definition: a basic structure of ideas or rules that you use to plan or build something
example: We built the app on a framework that handles authentication for us.
exampleEs: Construimos la app sobre un framework que maneja la autenticación por nosotros.
cloze: We built the app on a ____ that handles authentication for us.

definition: to make people notice something and think it is important
example: The report highlights several weaknesses in the current process.
exampleEs: El informe destaca varias debilidades en el proceso actual.
cloze: The report ____ several weaknesses in the current process.

definition: a strong effect that something has on a situation or a person
example: The new policy had a big impact on how we plan our week.
exampleEs: La nueva política tuvo un gran impacto en cómo planeamos la semana.
cloze: The new policy had a big ____ on how we plan our week.
note: Use 'impact on': a big impact on, not 'impact in'.

definition: certain to happen and impossible to avoid
example: With so many people editing the file, some conflicts are inevitable.
exampleEs: Con tanta gente editando el archivo, algunos conflictos son inevitables.
cloze: With so many people editing the file, some conflicts are ____.

definition: to separate something so that you can study it or stop it from affecting other things
example: First, we need to isolate the bug in a small test case.
exampleEs: Primero, tenemos que aislar el error en un caso de prueba pequeño.
cloze: First, we need to ____ the bug in a small test case.

definition: to change something slightly, usually to improve it
example: You can modify the settings without restarting the app.
exampleEs: Puedes modificar la configuración sin reiniciar la app.
cloze: You can ____ the settings without restarting the app.

definition: to watch or check something regularly over a period of time
example: We use a dashboard to monitor server performance in real time.
exampleEs: Usamos un panel para monitorear el rendimiento del servidor en tiempo real.
cloze: We use a dashboard to ____ server performance in real time.
note: False friend trap: the verb is 'monitor', not 'monitorize'.

definition: including everything, or considering the whole situation
example: The overall result was positive, even though one test failed.
exampleEs: El resultado general fue positivo, aunque una prueba falló.
cloze: The ____ result was positive, even though one test failed.
note: It is also an adverb: Overall, I think it went well.

definition: to take part in an activity or event
example: Everyone is encouraged to participate in the discussion.
exampleEs: Se anima a todos a participar en la discusión.
cloze: Everyone is encouraged to ____ in the discussion.
note: Always 'participate in', not 'participate at' or 'participate of'.

definition: a particular way of thinking about something
example: Talking to customers gave us a fresh perspective on the product.
exampleEs: Hablar con los clientes nos dio una perspectiva nueva sobre el producto.
cloze: Talking to customers gave us a fresh ____ on the product.

definition: to say what you think will happen in the future
example: The model is trained to predict which users will cancel next month.
exampleEs: El modelo está entrenado para predecir qué usuarios cancelarán el próximo mes.
cloze: The model is trained to ____ which users will cancel next month.

definition: most important, or first in order
example: Our primary goal this quarter is to reduce loading time.
exampleEs: Nuestro objetivo principal este trimestre es reducir el tiempo de carga.
cloze: Our ____ goal this quarter is to reduce loading time.

definition: not willing to do something and slow to do it
example: Some users are reluctant to share their location with an app.
exampleEs: Algunos usuarios son reacios a compartir su ubicación con una app.
cloze: Some users are ____ to share their location with an app.
note: Followed by 'to' + verb: reluctant to share.

definition: to show or tell something that was hidden or secret
example: The survey revealed that most employees prefer flexible hours.
exampleEs: La encuesta reveló que la mayoría de los empleados prefiere horarios flexibles.
cloze: The survey ____ that most employees prefer flexible hours.

definition: a change in the way people think about or do something
example: There has been a major shift from office work to hybrid work.
exampleEs: Ha habido un cambio importante del trabajo en oficina al trabajo híbrido.
cloze: There has been a major ____ from office work to hybrid work.
note: Also means a work period: the night shift.

definition: coming after something else in time or order
example: Subsequent versions of the app fixed the problem.
exampleEs: Las versiones posteriores de la app corrigieron el problema.
cloze: ____ versions of the app fixed the problem.
note: The adverb is 'subsequently'.

definition: to cause something to start or happen
example: A single failed payment can trigger a series of alerts.
exampleEs: Un solo pago fallido puede desencadenar una serie de alertas.
cloze: A single failed payment can ____ a series of alerts.
note: Also a noun: a trigger for stress.
